hypothesis: Test a small-network native CrossQ package with a predeclared short renormalization warmup against reproduced SAC; not an isolated normalization causal claim or reproduction of published large-network benchmarks.
data_scope: Same original22-stock/four-ETF training and development panel as reproduced SAC, train through2020/development2021-2023; no expanded-universe or feature change in this method screen.
intrinsic_differences: CrossQ joint current/next critic normalization, absent target critic, actor/entropy update every3critic updates, beta1=.5 and910 extra affine parameters. SAC actor everyupdate,beta1=.9,tau=.005 target. Common widths/lr/reward/data are fixed; not exactly equal parameter count or compute.
warmup_rationale: Native100000-update warmup would leave50k screen entirely in BatchNorm phase. Fix1000before learning for this bounded hypothesis; same warmup in4096-step smokes and50k screens; no tuning after returns. Strict steps>warmup condition means first renorm forward occurs on layer call1002.

shared_initialization.contract: Reuse only original unfitted full64 SAC archives. Copy actor/Gaussian-head and ordered live-critic Linear weights/biases exactly into CrossQ; preserve native zero/one/zero normalization parameters/buffers and absent target critic. Restore original SAC post-initialization Torch/NumPy/Python RNG to both arms. Empty optimizer/alpha/replay; no learned TQC/SAC tensors. Freeze portable archive/generation provenance before registry changes.

historical_control_reproduction.failure: Disable interpretation/promotion and report mismatch. Never widen tolerances or retry automatically.

selection_metric: Existing equal-weight26-symbol development net return; all checkpoints retained, selected and actual final post-update weights reported separately.
smoke_acceptance: Gym/SB3 checkers, actual copied tensors/RNG, phase-sensitive Adam/BatchRenorm counts, actual renorm forwards after warmup for both actor and critics, finite running moments, saved actor/critic/entropy state and replay/timeout restoration, frozen prediction/schema parity and immutable running moments. Smokes do not select settings. Both use full64 geometry.
update_counts: Post-update gradient count=max(0,steps-learning_starts); on-step checkpoint excludes current transition optimizer update. SAC actor/critic/entropy allupdate; CrossQ critic allupdate and actor/entropy floor(critic_updates/3). Measure actual per-parameter Adam and normalization counters; do not infer acceptance from nominal counters alone.
failure_policy: Close fixed CrossQ family after failed50k screen: no widths/lr/beta/delay/warmup/batch/reward/feature/step grid, extension or confirmation. Integrity/historical reproduction failure disables interpretation, requires investigation, no automatic retry or tolerance widening.
isolation: Treasury/VIX/GAE/TQC and prior failed families remain closed. No new data/provider/sector/rate features, no declined-stock future labels as inputs or selection, no retired2024+ data. Report true positive policy and short P&L separately.

execution.hardware_rule: Match actual default kernel before sync; profile actual learned smoke throughput before full screen. GPU only after CPU evidence justifies suitable hardware/cost; no assumed A100 benefit.
execution.concurrency: Configurable centrally metered fleet; persistent original crossq-study budget baseline shared across smoke/screen/retries; original project ledger never reset.
execution.cleanup: Durable bounded retrieval and verified owned shutdown on success/failure/interruption; stop on unreliable metering; never stop unrelated sessions; no automatic restart after budget/integrity stop.
